label: shot looks and the colour script

scenarios.why: Colder is a nudge to the shot's look, not a camera move; the shot is named by its story word.
A colour script is the palette of every shot across the scene, read without changing a shot.
Matching another shot's look copies its partial lighting and palette onto this shot.

scenarios.request: give the kitchen shot a cold isolation look
scenarios.why: Cold isolation is a look recipe named in story words; it sets the shot's light, not its framing.
A danger accent is the red-key recipe; the shot is named by its number in the cut.

scenarios.request: show me the palette of the sequence
scenarios.why: The palette across a sequence is the colour script, one column a shot.
Darker lowers this shot's exposure; no shot named means the one under the playhead.

scenarios.request: a lonely look for this moment
scenarios.why: Lonely with a look word reads as the cold isolation recipe, less sure than its own name.

scenarios.request: a close-up on Mara, she feels warm toward him
scenarios.why: Warm here is a feeling between people, not a colour request; the size is the camera action.
